body:
Welcome to 'Heroes' Team

Heyy Guys, I'm Ah_Roon, Today I have opened the Recruitment on Heroes Team.

Heroes Team is Fair-Play Player's Association.

If you want to join this team, Please contact me on Skype or Discord, I will response you an requests. Then I will send you an invitation on Discord & Avicus Teams invitation.

Good luck!

NOTE: Please do not send an requests here. Instead contact me on Discord or Skype.

Ah_Roon
- Heroes Team Leader

Update April 15th, 2017 1:36 PM GMT+9: Fixed some threads due to misunderstanding, Sorry for inconvenience.
